snippet.title: Coal Rush 1990 - Official Announcement Trailer | Mining Incremental Game
snippet.description:
⛏️ We're excited to introduce Coal Rush 1990, a brand-new mining incremental game set in 1990s Eastern Europe!

Meet Janusz. He's 21,370,000 PLN in debt, and his only chance to escape financial disaster is an inherited coal mine.

Start with a shovel, hire workers, dig for valuable resources, and build a fully automated mining empire.

💰 Dig. Sell. Upgrade. Automate. Repeat.

Can you help Janusz pay off his debt?

🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5490260/Coal_Rush_1990

#CoalRush1990 #IndieGames #IncrementalGame
